The reference image is the idle pose of this game's black cat ninja boss. Draw the SAME character (burly muscular black cat, purple headband with two tails, black ninja gi with a purple belt, a notch in one ear, narrow yellow eyes, a stern face) in an ATTACK pose: lunging to the LEFT with one big paw slashing forward, claws out, the other paw holding a single shuriken, purple belt tails flying. Keep the exact same character design, colours, proportions and art style as the reference - this is the same cat one moment later. Full body, facing LEFT, feet at the very bottom edge of the picture, fill the frame vertically.
Draw everything SOLID and OPAQUE - flat filled colour with soft shading. Nothing else in the picture: no ground line, no shadow, no scenery, no text, no letters, no watermark, no border.
Style: thick black outlines, flat colors with subtle soft gradients, cute cartoon look, not photorealistic.
Background must be a solid pure green (#00FF00), completely flat, for chroma keying. Nothing green on the character.
Output 1024x1024 PNG. Save the image as monsters__ninja_boss_attack.png in the current directory and report the path.
